backtest_protocol.execution_model: ProductWarrantyAccrual/StandardProductWarrantyAccrual instant facts are read from raw SEC Companyfacts and known only by filed date (<= signal date). Current and prior warranty/revenue ratios use annual revenue filed by the signal date and period-ended no later than the warranty reserve period. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: raw SEC companyfacts ProductWarrantyAccrual or StandardProductWarrantyAccrual instant facts
raw SEC companyfacts annual revenue facts
raw SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: raw SEC Companyfacts product warranty reserve burden falling versus revenue may identify companies with improving product quality or reduced after-sale cost risk; liquid SPY-relative leadership then tests whether the market is recognizing that quality before a 10-trading-day continuation leg.
interpretation: The product warranty reserve relief source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: target_sample_too_small, target_window_coverage_too_small, target_concentration_failed, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT product-quality evidence such as warranty-claims issued/payments decomposition, industry-normalized field-failure rates, product recall text joined to reserves, or closed forward replacement-value rows. Do not sweep warranty tag lists, reserve/revenue thresholds, fact freshness, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

2_history_check.exp-20260616-018: Rejected inventory-to-revenue leanness despite strong aggregate EV because old_thin and drawdown failed. This run is product warranty cost/risk relief, not inventory sell-through.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-005: Rejected depreciation/amortization burden relief. This run avoids asset useful-life accounting and tests after-sale warranty reserve burden.
2_history_check.exp-20260617-013: Rejected deferred-tax valuation allowance release on sample and concentration. This run tests product-quality cost reserves, not tax asset confidence.
2_history_check.history_scan: No prior committed experiment_log or experiments/logs entry used product warranty reserve relief as the decision field.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Warranty reserve relief is a distinct official SEC product-quality cost field not found in the recent SBC, inventory, tax, lease, debt, impairment, or reinvestment tests. Coverage scan shows broad raw Companyfacts availability, but prior Companyfacts scouts often failed old_thin/drawdown/comparator gates, so expected success is low.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC product warranty reserve or annual revenue facts, missing prior comparison point, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC product warranty reserve tag mapping, filed-date PIT annual revenue normalization, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
